exceptions.reason: Each case of the block renders `Menu.Trigger` and the other parts of Menu, which Vase UI does not have.

The case "handles interactions" of the block opens the popup with the keyboard, moves the focus to an item with the arrow keys, and gets the focus back on the trigger. It needs the list navigation and the focus manager of Select, which Vase UI does not have. The scroll arrows are the last part of Select, so the row names their file.
Each case of the block renders `Dialog.Trigger` and the other parts of Dialog from the entry point of Dialog. Vase UI does not have that entry point.
Each case of the block renders `AlertDialog.Trigger` and the other parts of Alert Dialog, which Vase UI does not have.
Each case of the block renders `Popover.Trigger` and the other parts of Popover from the entry point of Popover. Vase UI does not have that entry point.
